description:
Join our Wireless Software Engineering team and drive innovation that matters! We craft and seamlessly integrate technologies that enrich people’s lives such as audio, gaming, fitness, location and more; all while delivering the best user-experience. If you're a strong software engineer and are passionate about building awesome Bluetooth solutions, we may have the job for you. The Core Bluetooth team is looking for a motivated software engineer to design, implement, and maintain next generation connectivity solutions. You are responsible for crafting and developing world changing wireless protocols such as exposure notifications on the very latest Apple products.

Description
You will be challenged with unique problems: building and developing software solutions for the current and next generation of products and accessories. 


Responsibilities
Participate in the software integration of new Bluetooth features into Apple's premier products
Develop and support software integration of new Bluetooth hardware into products
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful product and feature launches


Minimum qualifications
You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical, or equivalent experience.
You have very strong C++, C and embedded software skills.
You have excellent analytical, problem-solving skills, programming and debugging skills.
Experience with AI tools, Claude and workflows.

Preferred qualifications
You're self-motivated and dedicated with validated creative and critical thinking capabilities.
You thrive in a collaborative environment and can clearly communicate while authoritatively driving multiple projects across many teams.
You're obsessively passionate and inquisitive, and seek to pursue everyday problems in innovative ways.
You're laser-focused on the smallest details that are meaningful to our customers.
Bluetooth or/and other wireless communication experience preferred.
all_locations: San Diego, United States of America
